attrs.evidence: bridge/film_check.mjs 13/13. The vertical witness: ic32_film emits APP-LAM at canonical locus 't:' for vector 3 (apply_id, ref_interactions = 1), and replaySemFilm accepts it on FloatRt and on the adversarial DescFloatRt. The frame's endpoints are the corpus vector's own initial and normal_form states, which the 48/48 bridge gate had already shown C and JS agree on byte-for-byte, so the new claim is exactly the TRANSITION between two states whose canonicalization was never in doubt. Seven forgeries, each RE-COMMITTED (frame_id and film_id recomputed) so it dies on a semantic check rather than on bookkeeping: F-1 wrong pre-state (sem-revision-mismatch), F-2 wrong post-state (sem-post-mismatch), F-3 a real rule at a wrong locus (sem-locus-not-enabled), F-4 a real redex misdescribed as a dup rule (sem-rule-mismatch), F-5 the honest film replayed against another source term (sem-revision-mismatch), F-6 a genuine C observation that cannot be re-pointed at another film, and F-7 an edit to the frame's DECLARED-NON-AUTHORITATIVE index i, which still REPLAYS and still loses provenance — replay and provenance being different verdicts. ic32_film.c #includes ic32_canon.c under IC32_CANON_NO_MAIN, so the canonicalizer beneath the film is the same code the bridge gate replays rather than a copy written for the occasion; the bridge stays 48/48 after the guard. Round 26 adds multi-frame-native-film and dup-cells-tolerated-rules-refused: the lowered add(const 2, const 3) emits SIX chained frames at t:fun · t: · t:bod.bod.fun · t:bod.bod · t:bod.bod.arg.arg.fun · t:bod.bod.arg.arg, every one APP-LAM, and replaySemFilm accepts the whole chain on FloatRt and DescFloatRt. lowering_check.mjs asserts the same chain at the refinement fixture, which is what upgrades derivation.lowering-refinement@1 from OBSERVED to FILM-EVIDENCED.
attrs.revision_note: SUPERSEDED by @2 at round 27 pass B3.2, and kept as history because its SCOPE sentence is the record of what the native emitter could do at v0.2.0. It is not wrong about anything it claims; it is narrower than what is now witnessed. Read it for the two scope corrections it documents -- PRESENCE to ENABLEDNESS, and the readback interaction-count check that was removed for being accidentally true -- neither of which @2 repeats at length.
attrs.statement: THE EXECUTION PLANE ORIGINATES EVIDENCE, RATHER THAN THE GOVERNANCE PLANE RECONSTRUCTING IT AROUND THE EXECUTION PLANE AFTERWARDS. For a frozen one-step fixture, the native C runtime independently emits a semantic-film frame whose pre-state, enabled rule, canonical locus, post-state and terminal status are accepted by the existing TRVM-SEMFILM-v1.1 contract WITHOUT normalization or translation of meaning — the law kernel's own replaySemFilm, imported unmodified, replaying on a fresh runtime. Every field is derived by the emitter from its own execution: the redex is found by an enumeration that mirrors findAppRedexes over ic32's packed-word heap, the rule is the rule that fired, quiescence is the same enumeration run again and required to be empty, and the readback is required to be PURE (resolving the state must cost no interaction). SCOPE, checked rather than assumed: MULTI-FRAME films over APP-plane rules, on terms that may CARRY dup cells, C→JS only. v0.1.0 scoped itself by dup PRESENCE and that was the right refusal for the wrong reason — the lowered add(const 2, const 3) carries dup cells and, under the leftmost-tree-app strategy, fires none, so the blocker was ENABLEDNESS all along. A term where a DUP-* rule becomes enabled is REFUSED BY NAME (film-dup-rule-enabled); so is a term already in normal form; and the terminal re-checks pool-quiescence rather than inheriting it from the loop. STILL UNBUILT and named: the six DUP-* rules, the d: and v: loci, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED terminals. AND ONE CHECK WAS REMOVED BECAUSE IT WAS ACCIDENTALLY TRUE. v0.1.0 asserted the readback fired ZERO interactions; on a one-step dup-free fixture resolving the state costs nothing, so a machine counter that never moved looked like a verified property. ic32's `interactions` is not plane-classified, so comparing it against zero measures a different quantity from the kernel's INTERACT-plane claim — it fires four on the lowered term whose state is nonetheless correct. The count is now REPORTED and pool-quiescence is what is ASSERTED. The C-side checker — films flowing the other direction — is not claimed. A film arriving from outside is an execution CLAIM exactly as a DeriveResult is, so film provenance uses the same discipline as derivation.implementation-provenance@4: the shared ObservedExecutionHost, an immutable catalog entry naming the binary, hash-then-launch, and an observation keyed over the whole emission rather than over the film alone — provenance is over everything the executor emitted, not over a subset a caller chose to present. REPLAY AND PROVENANCE ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY, because a film can be semantically perfect and its claimed provenance false; P-3F is exactly that case. THE TWO TRANSITION SYSTEMS STAY SEPARATE (film_planes): the TRVM calculus film is pre-state → (rule + locus) → post-state over the ic32 interaction-net relation, and the derivation evidence relation is DeriveRequest → evaluate → DeriveResult. What is shared is HOST INFRASTRUCTURE, not semantics.
